name: Maroof Mushtaq
positioning: Data scientist building forecasting, GenAI, and data systems that run in production.
tagline: M.Sc. Data Science (University of Stavanger). I turn messy real-world signals — energy time series, call transcripts, GIS — into models and products that ship.
bio: I'm a data scientist and software developer currently building data and analytics products at Nivel AS, where I've built an analytics platform on a BigQuery backend, shipped ETL pipelines into Google Cloud, and deployed a BigQuery MCP server so non-technical colleagues can query data in plain language.

My M.Sc. thesis — in partnership with Laerdal Medical — looked at limiting LLM hallucinations with knowledge graphs (GRAG vs RAG). Before Nivel I built energy-forecasting models at Baseline Energy, engineered data at DNB, and taught cloud computing and data-intensive systems as a TA at UiS.
I'm comfortable across the modern data stack and with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
